findings.title: Command Injection Risk in get_cli_string
findings.description: The `get_cli_string` function constructs a string intended for shell execution. When `value` contains spaces, it blindly wraps it in double quotes without escaping internal quotes or shell metacharacters (e.g. `value="123\"; rm -rf /; echo \""`). This leads to command injection if the result is executed by a shell.
findings.suggestion: Use `shlex.quote(value)` to safely escape arguments for shell execution instead of manually concatenating quotes.

findings.title: .env Configuration Injection via Unescaped Newlines
findings.description: In `set_key`, if `quote_mode='never'`, `value_to_set` is appended to the `.env` file verbatim. If an application uses this to store user input, an attacker can inject newlines (e.g., `value_to_set="foo\nADMIN=true"`) to inject or overwrite arbitrary `.env` variables.
findings.suggestion: Validate that `value_to_set` does not contain newline characters when `quote_mode='never'`, raising a `ValueError` if it does, or enforce quoting when newlines are present.

findings.title: Inefficient Environment Copying in resolve_variables
findings.description: Inside a loop over parsed `.env` variables, the entire `os.environ` dictionary is copied into a new `env` dictionary on every iteration (`env.update(os.environ)`). For environments with many variables, this creates an O(N * M) performance bottleneck.
findings.suggestion: Use `collections.ChainMap(new_values, os.environ)` to combine scopes efficiently without copying the entire dictionary on each iteration.

findings.title: Incorrect pre-commit Installation Command
findings.description: The documentation instructs users to run `$ uv run precommit install`, which will fail because the command is `pre-commit` (with a hyphen), not `precommit`.
findings.suggestion: Change the command to `$ uv run pre-commit install` or simply `$ pre-commit install`.

findings.title: test_run_without_cmd Does Not Test Missing Command Logic
findings.description: The test `test_run_without_cmd` attempts to assert the "No command given." branch in `cli.py`. However, it fails prematurely because `tmp_path` has no `.env` file, causing click to throw a `BadParameter` exception for the missing default file. The intended code path is never exercised.
findings.suggestion: Provide a mock `.env` file in the `tmp_path` fixture for this test, or explicitly pass a path to a valid empty file via the `--file` flag.

findings.title: Unhandled PermissionError during Command Execution
findings.description: When executing a command via `os.execvpe`, the code only catches `FileNotFoundError`. If the command points to a non-executable file or a directory, it will raise a `PermissionError` (a subclass of `OSError`), resulting in an unhandled traceback instead of a clean exit.
findings.suggestion: Catch `OSError` instead of just `FileNotFoundError` (or add a separate except block for `PermissionError`) to handle permissions issues gracefully.

findings.title: Unsafe Stack Traversal in find_dotenv Causes AssertionError
findings.description: The `find_dotenv` function climbs the call stack searching for an on-disk file. If the entire stack originates from built-ins, dynamic execution (`exec`), or unextracted zip archives, `frame.f_back` will eventually be `None`, triggering an `AssertionError` and crashing the application.
findings.suggestion: Replace `assert frame.f_back is not None` with an `if frame.f_back is None:` block that breaks the loop and falls back to `os.getcwd()` or an empty string.

findings.title: Unhandled TypeError When Current Working Directory Is Missing
findings.description: If the current working directory is deleted, `enumerate_env()` returns `None`. The `click` parameter `file` defaults to `None`, which is passed to `stream_file(None)`. Calling `open(None)` raises an unhandled `TypeError` instead of displaying a friendly error.
findings.suggestion: Add a check in the CLI commands for `if file is None:` and gracefully exit with an error message indicating that no `.env` file or working directory could be found.

findings.title: Duplicated Markdown Files Create Documentation Drift Risk
findings.description: `docs/index.md`, `docs/changelog.md`, and `docs/contributing.md` are exact copies of the root `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `CONTRIBUTING.md`. The repository includes `mkdocs-include-markdown-plugin` in its requirements but fails to use it in `mkdocs.yml`, leading to poor hygiene and out-of-sync documentation.
findings.suggestion: Configure the `mkdocs-include-markdown-plugin` in `mkdocs.yml` and replace the duplicated file contents with `!include ../README.md` directives, or remove the files and map them directly in the `nav` section.

findings.title: Use of Deprecated bumpversion Dependency
findings.description: The project lists `bumpversion` as a dependency. This package is deprecated, hasn't been updated since 2015, and has known incompatibilities with modern Python environments. It poses a minor supply chain risk.
findings.suggestion: Replace `bumpversion` with the actively maintained community fork `bump-my-version`.
